_purpose: Committed decision store that exercises the resolveBudgetOverrideAuthority authorized branch unconditionally, on every checkout including a fresh clone and CI. The real per-Story stores live under .vibepro/pr/<story-id>/decision-records.json, which .gitignore excludes, so OGB-S-8 had no authorized-branch coverage anywhere the artifacts are absent. This fixture supplies that coverage from a tracked file.
_digest_note: override_digest below is a literal, not a value recomputed by the test. computeBudgetOverrideDigest is therefore checked against a pinned expectation rather than against itself, so a change to the digest algorithm or to its canonical-JSON shape reddens this fixture instead of silently agreeing with it. Updating this digest must be a deliberate, reviewable edit.

override.amendment_reason: Fixture-only amendment prose. Excluded from the digest on purpose so this file can document itself without re-approval.

decisions.reason: Fixture grant. Present so the authorized branch, and every field the gate requires it to name, is executed on checkouts that have no .vibepro artifacts.
